ERROR: cannot extract package from ‘timriffe-Pyramid-7f8b4f7.tar.gz

Is this a secure process?  Can the user be sure that the uploaded data is not available to others?

Thanks in advance.

Hi Vojtech,
Typically when you see that "killed" line in your JavaScript console, it indicates that the application has taken up the maximum amount of memory alotted to the instance.  I see that you have already configured your application to be an xxlarge.  Is it possible that your running application takes up more memory as more and more users interact with it?

I also noticed this error in your logs (shinyapps::showLogs())  I don't believe it should be a contributor but I thought I would highlight it.

Warning in matrix(align.tmp[(2 - pos):(ncol(x) + 1)], nrow = nrow(x), ncol = ncol(x) +  :

2014-11-06T12:41:19.345632+00:00 shinyapps[shuttle]:   data length exceeds size of matrix

As for your question about availability of pricing and such, we are actually a day or two away from announcing our proposed pricing for the service once it is generally available.  We expect to move the service into Beta in the coming weeks, and to move it to GA in early Q1 of next year.

-Tareef

My Iris app is a simple ShinyApp for making a prediction about the iris class based on user-inputted petal length and width. It runs fine on my computer and seems to deploy successfully to ShinyApps.io, but when I go to the app's webpage, I get an error message saying that "The application unexpectedly exited. Diagnostic information has been dumped to the JavaScript error console."

My ShinyApp is at: https://dnaeye.shinyapps.io/iris/

messages.body_plain:
Hello,

Facing a problem when shiny app works fine locally, but when I upload application on server, a blank page appears with no error messages. No idea why this happens. Any help would be great.

# ui.r

library(d3Network)
require(RCurl)
library(Rfacebook)
library(shiny)
library(shinyIncubator)

shinyUI(fluidPage(

  # Load d3.js
  tags$head(tags$script(src = 'http://d3js.org/d3.v3.min.js')),

  h4(tags$b("Facebook network visualization")),

  progressInit(),

  fixedRow(
    fixedRow(
      column(3, offset=1,
             tags$div(class="header", checked=NA,
                                  list(
                                    tags$a(href="https://developers.facebook.com/tools/explorer/", h6(tags$b("Get your access token here!")),target="_blank")
                                  )

                                 ),

             textInput("token", h6(tags$b("Paste your access token here:")), ""),
             actionButton("goButton", tags$b("Update View!")))

      ),

    hr(),

    # Show network graph
    fixedRow(
      column(12,
             htmlOutput('networkPlot')
      )
    )
  )
))

#server.r

library(d3Network)
require(RCurl)
library(Rfacebook)
library(shiny)
library(shinyIncubator)

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {

  output$networkPlot <- renderPrint({

    if(input$goButton == 0)
      return(h6(""))

    withProgress(session, {
      setProgress(message = "Calculating, please wait",
                  detail = "This may take a few moments...")

    token <- input$token

    network <-getNetwork(token, format = "edgelist", verbose = FALSE)
    NetworkData <- data.frame(network)
    d3 <- d3SimpleNetwork(NetworkData,
                          width=1200,
                          height=700,
                          parentElement = "#networkPlot"
                          )
    })

  })
})

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] renderPrint do not work on shiny server
messages.subject_clean: [shinyapps-users] renderPrint do not work on shiny server
messages.body_plain:
Aleksandr,

I think the problem is that your d3.js file is not being loaded. This is because ShinyApps uses secure HTTPS by default. Because of this, all assets such as javascript files loaded from external sources need to also be loaded via HTTPS. You can see in the javascript console that the browser is blocking your d3.js file from being loaded because its not being loaded over HTTPS. However, the sad news is that the d3js website does not support HTTPS. So you will need to download the file and include it in your app.

For instructions on doing this, checkout this article on stack overflow <http://stackoverflow.com/questions/23599268/include-a-javascript-file-in-shiny-app>.

-Andy

Somehow, on the shinyapps Accounts page, it picked up my secondary email address rather than my primary email from gmail. I've since deleted my secondary email address on github.

So, can the accounts page reveal my primary email and not any other? How does this field get populated? Is it a concern at all?

Thanks,

messages.body_plain:
Ningning,
I think you want to have your data.csv at the top level, or if you wanted, you could have a data directory and use: read.csv("data/data.csv")
The www is for serving of static assets, and in this case you aren't serving that asset.
HTH
-Tareef

deployApp()

Since the basic package is limited to 25 active hours per month, does this mean that all of my hours will be depleted by this time tomorrow?  I feel like my apps should be sleeping, but I don't see an option to put them to sleep, only to archive them.

Andrew

Danilo,

The approach should be possible. Though I am not aware of anyone who has done this before.

Another question: Do you require a specific version of the X-13ARIMA data? Would it make sense for ShinyApps to automatically install the latest version from the US Census website when it detects you're using the seasonal package? We do something similar for other packages that have 3rd party dependencies.

-Andy

The data is geocoded and gets a result - i can see that from my console trying to run the app locally and from the log on the shinyapps.io <http://shinyapps.io/> dash board.
After the end of the geocode i get the next message:
.Warning in readLines(connect) :
  cannot open: HTTP status was '400 Bad Request'
Error in readLines(connect) : cannot open the connection

have a clue?

Thanks

Eliav

Hello!

I've tried to solve my problem by pasting the linux binary files in a new folder named 'linux'. Then I ask R for the running operating system and according to the answer I provide to seasonal package the appropriate file path. Here follows my code:

var_os <- switch(Sys.info()[['sysname']], Windows= 1, Linux  = 2)
path_windows <- file.path(getwd(),"X13/x13ashtml")
path_linux <- file.path(getwd(),"X13/linux/x13ashtml")
if(var_os==1){ Sys.setenv(X13_PATH = path_windows ) }
if(var_os==2){ Sys.setenv(X13_PATH = path_linux ) }

As I am a new user, I would like to know if it is possible to either check the folders where my code is hosted in shinyapp.io <http://shinyapp.io> or get the error message from the linux server.

Danilo

package, but it only gives you PDF output, in which case you still
have to convert PDF to PNG to display it on the web page. ImageMagick
might do it, but it is not installed on ShinyApps.

I'm not sure if you have looked at demo('plotmath'), which provides
another way to write LaTeX math in R plots, and it does not require
any additional software packages.

Thanks for the ideas. Let me provide a little more context on what I'm trying to achieve. Basically I'd like to render the results of the "tabular" function in package "tables" in shiny. The ideal approach is to convert the tabular object to html, which in theory is what the generic function "html" does, but it appears like a lot of features in the "tables" package are not supported by "html". On the other hand, "latex" supports all features, and I can easily generate a dvi or PDF file from latex. The problem is, I can't figure out a way to embed dvi or PDF in a web page with shiny (I tried renderImage); besides, an embedded PDF doesn't look nice anyway. That's how it led me to use "dvipng" to convert dvi to png to be used with renderImage. Hope that clarifies my question and I'm open to suggestions.

Thanks,
Yindeng

My app works great on shinyapps.io <http://shinyapps.io> but once uploaded to our company server the download function no longer works. At first we had issues with the write permissions as the app wasn't able to write a .png or .xlsx to the server but now we have changed this and the server responds with "no data received" but writes nothing to the error log. Then the app exits unexpectedly and says:

re-encoding from CP1252 Execution halted

Any ideas / pointers would be great!

Many Thanks

messages.subject: Error building package *.db bioconductor
messages.subject_clean: Error building package *.db bioconductor
messages.body_plain:
When deploying an app which uses org.Mm.eg.db (packages from bioconductor) I get this error:

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 3156726 failed: Error building image: Error fetching org.Mm.eg.db (3.0.0) source. Error downloading package source. Please update your BioConductor packages to the latest version and try again: HTTP 404: Not Found

I have updated BioConductor and it is the latest verison. The same problem persists if I use any other *.db .

Does anyone know how to deal with this?

Thanks!
Hena
